description: This Dart source file defines the AppDatabase class which manages the initialization, configuration, and access to an SQLite database for a Flutter expense tracker app. It handles creating the schema for categories, budgets, and transactions tables, applying migrations, seeding default data, and ensuring proper database setup and teardown.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for database initialization, schema creation, migrations, seeding, and providing access to the database instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, sets up schema, and applies migrations.

methods.name: _createV1Schema
methods.description: Creates the initial schema for the database version 1, including categories, budgets, and transactions tables.

methods.name: _seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds the database with default categories, budgets, and sample transactions if the tables are empty.
